text: AIA Group Limited is incorporated in Hong Kong and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 1299); it is the largest independent publicly listed pan-Asian life insurer. No state or state-fund owner.
short: AIA Group Limited is a Hong Kong-listed insurer.

source.name: AIA Group press release
source.quote: AIA Group Limited and its subsidiaries (collectively "AIA" or the "Group") comprise the largest independent publicly listed pan-Asian life insurance group.
